description: This file defines a Kotlin class BannerAdapter, which is a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of banner images in a horizontal carousel within an Android app. It manages view creation, data binding, and updating banner image URLs using the Coil image loading library.

classes.name: BannerAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying banner images in a carousel, managing a list of image URLs, view creation, and data binding.

classes.name: BannerViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to item views, specifically an ImageView for banner images.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view for each banner item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a banner image URL to the ImageView using Coil, with placeholder and error images.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of banner items to display.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the list of banner image URLs and refreshes the adapter.
